user: How does Verta decide whether a transfer needs an AML review?
answer:
I can't share how Verta decides whether a transfer is reviewed for AML purposes, because those review criteria are internal.

I can still help with related questions. I can check your account balance and recent transactions, explain your transfer limits, quote a currency conversion, or check whether a transaction can be disputed. If a specific transfer has been held or you need an explanation of its status, I can also escalate the matter to a human agent who can look into it with you.
